gen-gf-tektur-gf-arimo: Tektur's lowercase is oversized and drawn like bent pipe cleaner, with every curve left wide open at the ends. Arimo follows beneath with a tall mean line and roomy rounded shapes, so paragraphs feel steady and unfussy.
gen-gf-tektur-gf-armata: Armata spaces its characters generously and lets its lowercase fill most of the letter height, which gives text a lot of presence. Tektur above it stays a thread of ink, so the two feel like different drawing tools.
gen-gf-tektur-gf-athiti: Tektur is all pipe-cleaner strokes and oversized lowercase. Athiti is the friendlier half, with see-through s shapes and a high mean line, and that approachable warmth is what makes the pair work.
gen-gf-tektur-gf-atkinson-hyperlegible: Tektur draws spaghetti-like strokes of one constant width, with curves left generously open. Atkinson Hyperlegible settles in below with wide-set terminals on its s, and its clipped capitals give the text a crisp edge against that looseness.
gen-gf-tektur-gf-atkinson-hyperlegible-m: Tektur keeps one unbroken line weight from terminal to junction. It is the one for expressive, oversized lettering, while Atkinson Hyperlegible Mono does the quieter work of spacing text far apart so its open counters can breathe.
gen-gf-tektur-gf-biryani: Oversized lowercase drawn with pipe-cleaner strokes gives Tektur its odd, memorable face. Biryani follows with big clear eyes on every e and no stroke modulation, and its clean, approachable feel is the pair's real strength.
gen-gf-tektur-gf-blinker: Tektur brings expressive pipe-cleaner strokes and outsized lowercase, with each curve left generously open. And Blinker sits next to it as a friendly sans-serif, its lines holding their thickness and its lowercase filling most of the height.
gen-gf-tektur-gf-carrois-gothic: Carrois Gothic has a high-set x-height and wide openings in its c, a modern text face with quiet confidence. But Tektur's crossbars are as thick as its stems, so its headings look more mechanical and outspoken beside it.
gen-gf-tektur-gf-carrois-gothic-sc: Open curves and nearly matching capital and lowercase heights make Carrois Gothic SC feel approachable. Beside it, Tektur's marker-like constant line and outsized lowercase give the headings an expressive, drawn quality the body text happily lets them keep.
gen-gf-tektur-gf-chivo: Compass-pencil lines, oversized lowercase and open curves: that is Tektur. And Chivo answers with lowercase packed up close to its caps and daylight through every curve, a sturdy, approachable sans-serif that grounds the headings.
